solution.text:
On the unit circle ∥F ∥ = 1, so the scalar line integral is the circumference 2π. The field
points counterclockwise, opposite to the velocity everywhere in this traversal, so its work
is −2π. A vector work integral pairs with signed displacement; a scalar arc-length integral
does not.

question.text:
A continuous force field has norm at most 3 along a regular smooth curve of length 5. Its work
along the oriented curve is 15. What must hold at every point of the traversal?
(A) The force is zero.
(B) The force is perpendicular to the tangent.
(C) The force has magnitude 3 and points along the unit tangent.
(D) The force has magnitude 3 and points opposite to the unit tangent.
(E) The force is conservative on its entire domain.
